summary: Enhance your skills in crisis management with Logistics and Operations course. Learn effective strategies to navigate challenges and ensure smooth operations.
lede: Logistics crisis management helps supply chain and emergency-response professionals maintain critical resource flows when operations are disrupted. For coordinators, risk managers, humanitarian operations leaders and continuity planners, the course develops practical skills in assessing vulnerabilities, preparing emergency procurement and surge-capacity plans, mapping alternative routes, and coordinating last-mile distribution and multi-agency response.
audienceIntro: This training is specifically structured for professionals responsible for maintaining operational continuity, managing supply chain risks, and executing emergency response logistics under severe constraints.
modules: Foundations of Crisis Logistics and Operations
prerequisites: Participants must have a minimum of three years of experience in supply chain management, logistics, operations, or emergency response. A foundational understanding of standard inventory metrics, procurement processes, and transport operations is required. No advanced coding or technical engineering skills are necessary, as digital tools will be taught at an operational application level.
